title: Innovative label-free lymphoma diagnosis using infrared spectroscopy and machine learning on tissue sections.
summary: PLS-DA on infrared tissue spectra distinguished lymphoma from non-malignant lymphoid tissue on an independent test set (AUC 0.882). AI role: Partial least-squares discriminant analysis (PLS-DA) on ATR-FTIR spectra. The article appeared in Communications Biology.

organization: Department of Nephrology, Department of Internal Medicine and Pediatrics, Ghent University Hospital, Ghent, Belgium.; Department of Diagnostic Sciences, Ghent University, Ghent, Belgium.; Department of Pathology, Ghent University Hospital, Ghent, Belgium.
